## Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you are proposing.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or specific use case? Please describe.
Example: *I'm always frustrated when scanning single-page applications because...*

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision the feature working.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, tools, or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or reference materials about the feature request here.
